intent: Loop: continue a loop after its round limit (#39)
notes: M1 `loop/state_machine.py`: `extend` added to `_ARCHITECT_ACTIONS`; `_validate_architect_action` allows it only from `EXTENDABLE_STAGE` (`max_rounds_exceeded`) with an explicit "round limit" message. New `advance_extended(session, rounds, turn_timeout, message)`: max_rounds_exceeded -> plan_revision/draftor, `max_rounds += rounds`, preserves round/current/turns/decisions/unresolved_findings, resets plan_status="revision", blocked=False, resume + response fields, sets architect_message and a fresh deadline; all guards (stage, positive-int rounds, round <= ceiling) run before mutation. Tests: `TestAdvanceExtended`, `TestValidateExtendAction`. Charter: `scripts-loop.md` entry + TRIPWIRE "Resumable Terminal Stage"; RBAC tripwire lists `extend`.

M2 `loop/session.py`: shared `_validate_bounded_int()` now backs `validate_turn_timeout()` (messages unchanged) and new `validate_round_count()` (`ROUNDS_MIN/MAX` 1..20). `loop/submit.py`: new `handle_extend(token, rounds, message, loop_dir=None)` — required stripped reason + round validation + architect identity before the lock; stage check, `advance_extended()` (stored turn window), architect `extend` turn, and one `loop_extended` event (round, rounds_added, previous/new max_rounds, stage, next_role, reason, detail) inside it; rejections leave session/events byte-identical. Transaction only — single-active guard + watcher belong to `host.extend_loop()` (M3). `loop/events.py`: `loop_extended` formats as `EXTENDED`, not terminal. Tests: `TestValidateRoundCount`, `TestHandleExtend`. Charter: `scripts-loop.md` validator + `handle_extend` entries, handler count, event-format note.

M3 `loop/host.py`: `watch_loop()` terminal detection is now session-authoritative — a terminal event ends the watch only if `_session_is_terminal()` (fails safe to terminal on unreadable session); a watcher attached after an extension replays the old `max_rounds_exceeded` and keeps hosting. `_try_host_lock()` distinguishes held vs open-failure (`acquire_host_lock()` contract unchanged). New `acquire_host_lock_with_retry()` -> `(fd, attached|already_hosted|failed, detail)` with injectable sleep, plus best-effort `read_host_metadata()`. New `extend_loop()` holds `start.lock`, refuses when a different loop is active, delegates to `handle_extend()`, releases in `finally`. Tests: `TestWatchLoopReplay` (verified failing without the fix), `TestHostLockRetry`, `TestExtendLoopGuard`. Charter: `scripts-loop.md` watch_loop session-authoritative rule + tail_events note, lock-retry/metadata/extend_loop entries, start.lock callers, host.py ownership.

M4 `loop/cli.py`: new `gator loop extend --token --rounds <1-20> --message "..."` (`_cmd_extend`, `_round_count_arg`). Required args; bad rounds are usage errors (exit 2) before any write. Calls `host.extend_loop()`; rejections exit 1 before any host step. On success prints old -> new ceiling, resumed stage/role, turn window, and a participant re-engagement notice, then always applies the host contract: attached -> foreground `watch_loop()` (Ctrl+C reports enforcement stopped; fd released in `finally`), already_hosted -> exit 0 with holder detail, failed -> exit 1 stating the extension is saved but timeouts are NOT enforced. Architect status shows an `extend` hint only for `max_rounds_exceeded`; `start` banner lists `extend`. Tests: `TestCliExtend`. Charter: `scripts-loop.md` `_cmd_extend` entry, subcommand counts (13).

M5a `gator-dashboard.py` (refactor, no behavior change): new `_ensure_loop_watcher(repo_path, loop_id, loop_dir, retry=False)` is the single Dashboard watcher attach path — returns `already_hosted` for a live in-process thread or a lock held elsewhere, acquires `host.lock` (one attempt, or the ~3 s retry window when `retry=True`), inserts the nonce-protected `_HostEntry` before `t.start()`, and on start failure removes the entry by nonce and releases the fd. `_handle_loop_start()` and `_adopt_orphaned_loops()` now use it (start still returns 500 `failed to acquire host lock` / `failed to start host watcher`; adoption still skips held locks). Existing `TestHostOwnership` / `TestWatcherLifecycle` / `TestConcurrentStart` pass unchanged. Charter: `scripts-dashboard.md` host-registry entry with the single-attach-path invariant.

M5b `gator-dashboard.py`: new POST `/loops/<id>/extend` (`_handle_loop_extend`, routed via the action-suffix map) and `_validate_http_round_count()` (JSON int 1..20, strings rejected). Body validated before any write (400); then `host.extend_loop()` (start.lock + single-active guard + transaction) and `_ensure_loop_watcher(retry=True)`. Response `{ok, previous_max_rounds, max_rounds, round, watcher, watcher_detail}`; wrong stage / another active loop / start in progress -> 409. Extension stays durable when the watcher fails, and the response says so. Tests: `TestLoopExtend` — attach exactly one watcher (plus in-process already_hosted and a stage-rejected repeat), cross-process held lock -> already_hosted with no watcher, holder releasing mid-retry -> attached, watcher failure reported honestly, another active loop and held start.lock -> 409, non-extendable stages -> 409, nine invalid bodies -> 400, all rejections byte-unchanged; cleanup asserts watcher exit, registry removal, and host.lock release. Charter: `scripts-dashboard.md` `_handle_loop_extend` + round-count validator entries.

M6 `dashboard/views/loop.js` + CSS: `max_rounds_exceeded` outcome shows a **Continue loop** control (`renderContinueControl()`): Additional rounds (1..20, default 2, mirrors `ROUNDS_MIN/MAX`) + **Reason (required)**; Confirm disabled until a non-blank reason; invalid rounds/blank reason refused before any request with text errors; POSTs `{rounds, message}` to `/extend`. Other terminal stages keep no controls; `controlsFingerprint()` includes the extendable-stage flag. On success `showExtendNotice()` writes old -> new ceiling + re-engagement step (and a **Warning:** line when the watcher failed / neutral line when already hosted) into a new unpatched `#loop-region-notice` skeleton region, then `ensurePolling()` restarts the interval, the sidebar refreshes, and the #38 incremental path patches header/prompts/controls live while preserving timeline and artifacts. `EVENT_LABELS.loop_extended = "Extended"`. Tests (Playwright): visibility per terminal stage, client validation sends nothing, success goes live in place (same root, prompts + live controls, polling on, expanded artifact kept, Extended card appended, notice survives polls), watcher-failure warning text, server 409 keeps the dialog for retry. Charter: `scripts-dashboard-ui.md` Continue control, notice region, polling restart, terminal-is-not-always-final, known CLI-extension-while-viewing limit.

M7 protocol + records: `gator-loop-protocol.md` (`.gator/.includes/` + byte-identical starter copy) — Rule 10 keeps "terminal means done" for participants (now also lists `ended_by_architect`) and documents the Architect-only `max_rounds_exceeded` extension: do not wait/poll for one; the Architect re-engages participants with a fresh join prompt; read the `Architect message:` reason; Draftor revises against `findings.current.md`; no other terminal state resumes. State Machine table completed (review P2): adds the existing `paused_by_architect` and `ended_by_architect` rows, marks final vs. extendable terminals, and replaces the "first three / last four" line with Active (3) / Paused (2) / Terminal (4) summaries including exit-code behavior. Pins: `TestWaitHandoffAlignment::test_protocol_documents_architect_extension` and `::test_protocol_state_table_matches_state_machine` (table + summaries derived from `state_machine` stage sets). `scripts-cross-cutting.md`: `loop_extended` additive/non-terminal event (session schema unchanged), shared round-count validator authority, session-authoritative watcher rule + start.lock on every revival, and the new protocol pin in the shipped-copy tripwire. CHANGELOG entry deferred to release.
